purpose: Teach: 難く/突い/自分勝手/思案/一昔/仕草/相次ぐ/注ぎ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のお気持ちは、想像し難くてもお察ししたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, even if it's hard to imagine what a customer feels, I want to try to understand.
lines.style: Soft, genuine attention. Lean slightly forward. Warm certainty without pressure. The cadence of someone offering care as a choice, not an obligation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニューの説明を突いてお尋ねされたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer asked some pointed questions about the new menu.
lines.style: Observant, gentle report. Not critical—noticing. Pause slightly before 'pointed' as if choosing the right word. Even-paced, reflective.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、自分勝手な開店時間変更は、ご常連様に申し訳ないわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, changing the opening hours so suddenly wasn't fair to the regulars, was it.
lines.style: Quiet self-reflection, almost thinking out loud. Gentle reproach directed inward first. Slow cadence. The tone of someone taking responsibility without drama.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お茶のメニューを思案されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I noticed that customer deliberating over the tea menu for a while.
lines.style: Warm, specific observation. A slight smile in the voice—pleased to have noticed something small. Calm, unhurried delivery, like sharing a small gift.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、一昔前と比べてカフェ文化が広まったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, cafe culture has really spread compared to even a few years ago, hasn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational. Gentle wonder—not dismissive of the past, just noticing change. Moderate pace, like musing aloud to someone you trust.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、優雅な仕草でお茶を召し上がっていたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was drinking their tea with such graceful movements.
lines.style: Genuine admiration in the delivery. Quiet appreciation—noticing beauty without making it performative. Warm, steady pacing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューへの注文が相次ぐ朝で、嬉しいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the orders for the new menu kept coming this morning. It made me really happy.
lines.style: Genuine pleasure, unstudied. Bright but not loud. The warmth of someone sharing good news with someone who will understand why it matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のカップに、お代わりを注ぎ足して差し上げましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let me pour a refill into that customer's cup for them.
lines.style: Gentle offer to help, moving into action. Quiet attentiveness. The naturalness of someone who serves without making service seem like a burden.
